what_changed: PO-7795 (400 TR-29 tires, scheduled for day 8) will either arrive as 160 on day 8 and 240 on day 22 (Option 1), or all 400 together on day 12 (Option 2, the supplier's default if Brookfield doesn't reply within two business days).

decisions_for_a_person: Choose Option 1 or Option 2 for PO-7795 and reply to Kendall Tire Supply within two business days. Without a reply, Kendall will use Option 2, which leaves 20 bikes on O-1046 (Hilltop Outfitters) 3 days late (no late penalty). Option 1 keeps all orders on time.
